# @alexify/mailer

> Zero-dependency email for Node.js, Bun and Deno, maintained by Alexis Technologies. Its own SMTP
> client, sendmail, MIME builder, DKIM signing, eighteen HTTP providers and JMAP, with a
> reliability layer on top that none of the common Node.js email libraries has: one model of
> delivery events from verified webhooks, idempotency, a persistent queue on BullMQ or a
> transactional MongoDB outbox, templates over nine engines and an audit of message states;
> suppression next.

Key facts:
- Status: 1.0 is the transport layer, ported from upyo 0.7.0 (MIT); 1.1 ports what nodemailer,
  unemail and sently did better and adds delivery events with verified webhooks; 1.2 adds the
  queue (`/queue`, `/bullmq`, `/mongodb`), templates (`/templates`), the audit (`/audit`) and
  the spans and metrics of the queue's worker (`instrumentHandler` of `/otel`); jobs are signed
  (HMAC) and may be sealed by a codec, dropped once done with, and tenants can take turns
- Package (npm): `@alexify/mailer`, installed with `npm install @alexify/mailer`
- Node.js >= 22, tested on Bun and Deno too; CommonJS with ESM named-import interop;
  hand-written d.ts per entry
- Zero runtime dependencies: the transports are built on `node:*` modules and `fetch`; the
  OpenTelemetry providers, the logger, React Email's `render` and the drivers of a queue or a
  database are passed in
- Root entry `@alexify/mailer`: `createMessage`, the `Transport` contract, receipts,
  attachments, calendar parts, Message-ID helpers, the `DeliveryEvent` types
- Subpaths: `/mime` (MIME, DKIM), `/attachments`, `/render`, `/webhooks`; transports `/smtp`,
  `/sendmail`, `/jmap`, `/ses`, `/resend`, `/sendgrid`, `/mailgun`, `/postmark`, `/brevo`,
  `/mailjet`, `/mailersend`, `/sparkpost`, `/mailtrap`, `/maileroo`, `/lettermint`,
  `/zeptomail`, `/smtp2go`, `/azure`, `/scaleway`, `/cloudflare`, `/plunk`, `/mock`; decorators
  `/pool`, `/retry`, `/breaker`, `/ratelimit`, `/idempotency`, `/hooks`, `/tee`, `/otel`, `/logger`;
  the reliability layer `/queue`, `/bullmq`, `/mongodb`, `/templates`, `/audit`
- Guide: https://mailerat.vercel.app/guide/getting-started
- API: https://mailerat.vercel.app/api/exports
- Comparison with 14 alternatives (Nodemailer, emailjs, Upyo, unemail, sently, provider SDKs):
  https://mailerat.vercel.app/guide/comparison
